transcript.answer: The retention period has to be set explicitly through the required `CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS` environment variable. It has no default and is not clamped. It is read through `enforceExists`, and it must be a whole number of days from 1 to 999999. Any other value, or a missing one, stops the api before the port opens, and the error names the variable and the value. The upper bound keeps the cutoff a date MongoDB can compare. The period is a legal (GDPR) decision, not a code decision. It is also separate from the store's `maxAgeMs`, which only bounds in-memory cache and erases nothing. In the Helm chart, `charts/otto` passes `api.conversationRetentionDays` to the api (FR-094). A spec requirement (CR-002) says the number of days must be taken from a source that the excerpt cuts off, so I can't say what that source is.
